translation_loss.what_was_lost: The translation renders 'आँगन' (aangan) as 'garden', which loses the specific cultural and architectural nuance of a traditional Indian home's central open courtyard. Additionally, 'वन' (van) literally means forest or woods, so 'आँगन का शांत वन' evokes a quiet forest within a courtyard, a rich juxtaposition simplified to 'quiet garden'.

The translation of 'चुप्पी का छुपा है' as 'Silence is hidden' loses the grammatical flow and the specific possessive construction 'का' (ka) which links silence to the hiding, as well as the adverbial depth of 'गहराई से' (profoundly/with depth) being split into 'Profoundly it sits' which adds an unwritten verb 'sits'.

The translation 'Where every breath sings' introduces the active verb 'sings' which is not present in the original 'जहाँ हर साँस में' (where in every breath), altering the quiet, passive presence of the music of dreams within the breath.

annotation.theme: The profound silence and dreamlike music found within a quiet courtyard garden

original_poem:
आँगन का शांत वन,  
कितना सुन्दर है।  
हर पत्ते पर,  
हर फूल पर,  
चुप्पी का छुपा है,  
गहराई से।  
आँगन का शांत वन,  
जहाँ हर साँस में,  
सपनों का संगीत है।
translated_poem:
The quiet garden,  
How beautiful it is.  
On every leaf,  
On every flower,  
Silence is hidden,  
Profoundly it sits.  
The quiet garden,  
Where every breath sings,  
The music of dreams.
